title: Bridge Handshake Wizard and Upgrade Slimline Frames
creator: Maya Lin
description: Design and asset production for a compact, operator-focused onboarding flow that demonstrates the VPC bridge 'handshake' (network negotiation + credential exchange), plus a slimline upgrade modal and rollback preview. Deliverables: high-fidelity artboards for the wizard (desktop and narrow-width), a condensed CLI copy block for offline installs, a minimal network topology minimap animation, and a small set of upgrade/rollback screenshots for the release notes. The goal is to support first-time operators and SREs during Private deployments by reducing cognitive load while preserving necessary debug affordances (expandable logs, copy-SSH/psk buttons).
